mentions.name: Zen
mentions.description: A system-wide desktop ad-blocker and privacy guard that filters ads and tracking at the network level, covering not just browsers but also desktop applications. Motivated by the shrinking space for browser-based ad-blockers (e.g., Google killing Manifest V2 in Chrome) and the prevalence of ad/tracking traffic in native desktop apps.
mentions.problem: Browser-based ad-blockers are being hindered (e.g., Google re-activating efforts against them by killing Manifest V2 in Chrome), and desktop apps also load ads and tracking that browser extensions cannot reach, so network-level system-wide filtering is needed.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a system-wide desktop ad-blocker and privacy guard called Zen (for almost 2.5 years now): https://github.com/irbis-sh/zen-desktop
